commentary.text: 90+15' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+12' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) receives a red card and walks off the field of play!
90+10' Alemao (Rayo Vallecano) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
90+9' 3 - 3 It's a goal! Pedro Diaz sends a long raking pass onto the head of Alemao (Rayo Vallecano), who makes no mistake from close in and sends the ball into the top right corner. 3:3.
90+7' There's an opportunity for Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
90+7' The referee can't ignore those comments and Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) sees a yellow card for bad language.
90+7' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) is arguing with the referee and is given a caution.
90+6' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alex Remiro intercepts the ball.
90+5' What a chance that is! Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar.
90+4' Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
90+3' Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Sociedad.
90+3' Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
90+1' It is time for a substitution. Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) is on for Sergio Gomez.
90' 11 additional min. will be played.
90' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) was too forceful with his tackle and Jose Guzman interrupted the game to signal a free kick.

84' 2 - 3 Ilias Akhomach feeds the ball through to Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the bottom left corner! The goalkeeper was helpless. 2:3!
84' Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

83' Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Rayo Vallecano are going to take it.
81' The referee signals a substitution. Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano) is brought on as a substitute for Unai Lopez.
79' It looked like the long-range shot by Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) would end up in the net, but the effort went slightly over the bar. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.
76' 1 - 3 Goal! Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Dani Cardenas into the roof of the net.
76' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
75' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) has tested the patience of referee Jose Guzman and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
75' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal due to a foul. The Rayo Vallecano players look gutted.
73' Although Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) is just on the bench, Jose Guzman has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
73' Having seen unsporting behavior, Jose Guzman shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Nobel Mendy (Rayo Vallecano) is the recipient.
71' The Rayo Vallecano players halt their celebrations as referee Jose Guzman makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
69' Goal! Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) takes a short pass from Alemao in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner. 2:2.
69' Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
68' That's the end of the game for Isi Palazon, who is replaced by Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano).
67' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yangel Herrera (Real Sociedad) replacing Benat Turrientes.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jon Gorrotxategi (Real Sociedad) replaces Orri Oskarsson.
66' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
66' A quickly taken corner by Rayo Vallecano.

66' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the left side of the goal, but Alex Remiro thwarts him with a great two-handed save. It will be a corner kick for Rayo Vallecano.
64' Substitution. Nobel Mendy makes his way off the pitch and Alemao (Rayo Vallecano) comes on as his replacement.
64' Here is a change. Sergio Camello is going off and Inigo Perez gives the last tactical orders to Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano).
64' Substitution. Carlos Martin did his best and is replaced by Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano).

63' 1 - 2 GOAL! Superb work from Sergio Gomez, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad), who beats Dani Cardenas with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 1:2.

62' Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the left post is blocked by Dani Cardenas, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
61' The foul by Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) was seen by Jose Guzman who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
60' The goalkeeper pulls off a save to deny Carlos Martin (Rayo Vallecano), whose low effort is only aimed at the middle of the goal.
59' Dani Cardenas pulls off a great save to deny Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal.
56' Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
56' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to substitute Ander Barrenetxea and he is replaced by Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad).
56' Substitution. Takefusa Kubo is replaced by Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad).
55' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
51' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes high over the bar.
51' Alex Remiro pulls off a great save to deny Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
49' Jon Martin (Real Sociedad) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
49' Jose Guzman shows a yellow card to Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) for his blatant foul.
47' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
46' The attendance for today's match is 12845.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' Jose Guzman blows his whistle. Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) commits a foul after dangerous play.
45+4' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
45+4' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jose Guzman blows his whistle for a foul.
45+1' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
45' Real Sociedad quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
44' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away. The ball goes out of play. Real Sociedad are awarded a corner kick.
44' Nobel Mendy (Rayo Vallecano) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jose Guzman blows for a foul.
40' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
37' Rayo Vallecano take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
36' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Rayo Vallecano earn a corner.
36' Carlos Martin (Rayo Vallecano) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
34' Rayo Vallecano seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
30' 1 - 1 Goal! Ilias Akhomach tees up Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom left corner. 1:1.
29' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) criticises the decision of the referee and immediately receives a yellow card.

28' Carlos Martin sprays a wonderful pass out to Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano), who cannot get enough power or direction to cause Alex Remiro problems and the goalkeeper is able to watch the ball go just over the crossbar.
26' The goal by Rayo Vallecano is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a handball.
25' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was a handball in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Rayo Vallecano players aren’t happy.
23' Andrei Ratiu provides Carlos Martin (Rayo Vallecano) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a low shot into the middle of the goal.
22' 0 - 1 Goal! Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Ander Barrenetxea, then sends the ball into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
17' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
16' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails a few inches over the bar!
15' Jose Guzman blows his whistle and it's Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
14' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

14' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag and Real Sociedad will take a corner.
13' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
12' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jose Guzman saw the whole situation.
10' Carlos Martin (Rayo Vallecano) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
9' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
8' Ilias Akhomach (Rayo Vallecano) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
7' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
6' Real Sociedad fail to score from a corner as Dani Cardenas (Rayo Vallecano) leaps to collect the ball.

6' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick.
5' A pass finds the feet of Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) on the edge of the box and he sends in a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's easily gathered by the goalkeeper.
3' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) swings in a cross from the corner, but Alex Remiro reads it well and gathers the ball.

3' Ilias Akhomach (Rayo Vallecano) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Rayo Vallecano will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
2' Duje Caleta-Car (Real Sociedad) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the left post! What a huge opportunity!
2' Real Sociedad work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
2' Half-chance! Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) plays a pass into the box, but Dani Cardenas reacts well to snuff out the attack. The ball goes out of play. Real Sociedad are awarded a corner kick.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Rayo Vallecano will have the kick-off.
Jose Guzman was nominated as the referee for this game.
